input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including user, role, instant message builder, instant message. The platform provides capabilities for user, default user, user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage instant message builder records, so that I can track and organize instant message builder data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage instant message records, so that I can track and organize instant message data effectively.
